annotation.title_clean: Towards Trustworthy Physical Intelligence: From Theory to Practice Across the Life Cycle
annotation.title_en: Towards Trustworthy Physical Intelligence: From Theory to Practice Across the Life Cycle
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Yang, W.; Liu, H.; Xu, X.; Menon, A.; Cai, X.; He, Y.; et al.
annotation.summary_en: Survey proposing a trustworthiness framework for physical intelligence (embodied AI, robots, autonomous vehicles). It introduces T-PAIO, operationalizing governance across five life-cycle stages, and the T-PAI framework organizing principles: robust and safe operation, human-centered values, integrity/privacy/equity, accountability and oversight, and sustainability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Existing trustworthy AI frameworks, built for digital systems, miss physical safety, cyber-physical security and manufacturing issues.
T-PAIO operationalizes governance elements across five life-cycle stages: research, design, data, model, deployment.
T-PAI organizes five principle clusters: robust and safe operation, human-centered values, integrity/privacy/equity, accountability and oversight, sustainability.
Failures propagate across life-cycle stages and cause irreversible physical consequences, illustrated by humanoid and robotaxi incidents.
Proposes measurable traceability and provenance criteria for robot learning data, with release conditioned on full lineage.
